title: Statistical moments, risk weighting and percentiles of a loss distribution of a finite homogeneous credit portfolio; extending the Vasicek distribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.25881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Vasicek distribution assumes an infinite portfolio of identical obligors and forms the basis of the Basel III/IV Risk Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation. We derive the central moments of the loss distribution for a finite number (n) of obligors. We use these moments to calculate percentiles of the fraction (x) of defaulted obligors, via the Cornish-Fisher expansion and via a weighting method. Both methods are based on scaling the standard deviation in x by a capital multiple. The weighting method assumes that the capital multiple is linear in the central moments and leads to an Extended Vasicek distribution. We apply this distribution in calculating an adjusted RWA for small portfolios. translated_title: 有限同质信用组合损失分布的统计矩、风险加权与分位数；Vasicek分布的扩展
translated_abstract: Vasicek分布假设组合由无限多个相同的债务人构成，并构成了巴塞尔III/IV风险加权资产（RWA）计算的基础。我们推导了有限数量（n）债务人组合损失分布的中心矩。我们利用这些矩，通过Cornish-Fisher展开和一种加权方法来计算违约债务人比例（x）的分位数。这两种方法都基于用资本倍数对x的标准差进行缩放。加权方法假设资本倍数与中心矩呈线性关系，由此导出了扩展Vasicek分布（Extended Vasicek distribution）。我们将该分布应用于计算小型组合的调整后RWA。模拟结果显示，这种调整仅对少于100个债务人的小型组合才有意义，且扩展Vasicek分布使得对包含不同评级等级的组合进行解析式风险资本计算成为可能，即使当数……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文通过推导有限规模同质信用组合损失分布的中心矩，提出了扩展Vasicek分布，可用于小型组合的风险加权资产调整计算，并支持含不同评级等级组合的解析式风险资本计算。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the central moments of the loss distribution for finite homogeneous credit portfolios and proposes an Extended Vasicek distribution, enabling adjusted RWA calculations for small portfolios and analytical risk capital calculations for portfolios with different rating grades.
